items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Was he as good as Eddie Jackson?

ctx.x: Yeah, Pills. He played in the street?

Yeah, Pills. He played in the street all the time, man. He got limp, limp. He didn't kill. Pills shook. And, he was a trumpet. He was a trumpet. He was a trumpet. Pills shook. And, and that big, big fella on, on two world, you know, and, big tall dog fella. Was he good? Yeah, man. He got the best grand. I can't call his name. Was he as good as Eddie Jackson?
That's what I'm talkin' about, Eddie Jackson.
